summary: Tests-only red-phase PR for issue #5 (generated OpenAPI Swift client). 14 new tests: 10 spec/toolchain coverage tests in OpenAPIClientGenerationTests (red until the spec is vendored, deps declared, and client generated) and 4 stubbed-response wire-contract tests in APIClientWireContractTests (3 green characterization tests pinning current behavior through the swap; 1 red test for the missing fetchRankedResults surface, reached via a default-implementation protocol witness that flips green when APIClient gains the exact method). Criteria are intentionally not yet satisfied; the implementation run (after paid-tests-approved) turns them green. Swift toolchain is absent in the authoring container, so the suite was not executed locally; CI (macos-latest, swift test) is the executor and docs/openapi-client-test-plan.md records the expected red/green split per test.

references.result: expected red: iOS/OpenAPI/color-matching-api.json not vendored yet (depends on viamin/color_matching#110)
expected red: Package.swift lacks swift-openapi-generator/swift-openapi-runtime and the GenerateOpenAPIClient plugin
expected red: no Sources/**/OpenAPIGenerated/ output yet
expected red: spec missing; will verify all six surfaces (recent, manifest, captures, measurements, judgments, ranked_results) with operationIds
wire characterization of manifest decoding (path, bearer auth, prose payload); passes at this head and must stay green after models are replaced
wire characterization of recent sheets incl. null title; passes at this head
pre-existing encoding tests for capture/measurement/judgment payloads; must stay green through the swap

verification.note: Deleting the hand-written Codable request/response types is verified by code review of the implementation PR; the automated half is the wire-compatibility suite above.

references.result: not_run locally: no Swift toolchain in the authoring container; four stubbed-response tests exist (WireStubURLProtocol, no live server) and run in CI via swift test
delta-recording protocol defined: each spec-coverage failure names a prose-contract expectation the published spec misses; the implementation PR description must tabulate deltas and endpoint gaps

verification.note: The delta table itself is authored with the implementation PR; cannot exist at this tests-only head.
